queue=apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)
current=[s for s in queue if s.get('is_current') or s.get('is_playing')]
print('current_matches:', current)
# Determine current position
cur_pos=max([s['position'] for s in current]) if current else None
print('cur_pos:', cur_pos)
played=[s for s in queue if s['position']<=cur_pos]
print('played_so_far_filtered:', [{'song_id':s['song_id'],'title':s['title'],'position':s['position']} for s in played])
results=[]
for s in sorted(played, key=lambda x:x['position']):
    r=apis.spotify.like_song(song_id=s['song_id'], access_token=access_token)
    results.append((s['song_id'], r))
print('like_results:', results)
